## PR title

`Render bullet markers at every nesting depth in DOCX list rendering`

## PR body

```markdown
## Summary

DOCX converter rendered list bullets only for the first two depths, so
depth-3+ list items came out as plain paragraphs. This PR removes the
depth cap and centralizes the indent logic.

## Root cause

`docx_converter._render_list_item` short-circuited at MAX_DEPTH=2,
dropping the bullet marker. The depth limit existed to bound the indent
string, but mistakenly suppressed the marker too.

## Fix

1. Remove the MAX_DEPTH guard from the call site.
2. Centralize the indent logic in a new `_list_indent` helper module so
   PDF and DOCX rendering can share it.
3. Add a unit-test file for the new helper.

## Verification

`tests/test_docx_converter.py::test_three_level_nested_list_keeps_bullets`
passes on this branch, fails on main. The new helper module has 4 unit tests
in `tests/test_list_indent.py`.
```
